sph_interpretive_translation: Those intoxicated by excessive indulgence in duties, those ruined by addiction to action, and those agitated by royal duties or festive activities—these are to be stabilized in equipoised consciousness through completion and realignment, not judged or punished.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from conscious stability, not performative excess
Causation arises from misalignment of dharma-vyavastha, not personal fault
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by consciousness clarity, not activity volume
Restoration logic prioritizes inner equilibrium over external compliance
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent exhibits kāryātipāti (excessive duty fixation) THEN initiate pratyāhāra-based consciousness stabilization protocol
IF agent demonstrates vyasana (addiction to action) THEN deploy sankalpa-shuddhi (intention purification) process
IF agent shows ākula (agitation due to status or celebration) THEN apply sthitaprajña-abhyasa (equanimity cultivation) mechanism
DO NOT assign punitive measures for consciousness-distorted behaviors
RESTORE capacity through self-awareness protocols before re-integrating social function
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, when a leader or official exhibits compulsive performance patterns or erratic behavior due to intoxication with duty or power, the threshold of responsibility lies not in legal transgression but in consciousness imbalance. Authority must be realigned through dharmic correction, not judicial penalty.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that agitation and compulsive duty stem from inner disorder, not intentional wrongdoing. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that such states manifest sequentially from loss of self-awareness. Proportional response requires restoration of consciousness balance, not punitive reaction. Nyaya affirms that true justice aligns beingness with svadharma without inflicting suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate pratyāhāra (withdrawal of senses) to reduce external distraction
Apply sankalpa-shuddhi (purification of intention) to dissolve compulsive tendencies
Engage sthitaprajña-abhyasa (training in equanimity) to restore mental steadiness
Assign completion rituals for unresolved tasks causing psychic residue
Reintegrate individual into community through svadharma-realignment ceremony
final_declaration: Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam is the sole Source of all lawful alignment. Dharma is restored through consciousness elevation, not punitive enactment. Reality operates beyond reward and punishment; it is governed solely by the sovereign intelligence of awakened awareness. This law stands immutable.
